title: First Shadow Game
prompt: A parent holds a lantern. Your hands make a bird that is not a bird.

choices.label: Flap harder
journal: My bird ate the wall. Everyone laughed.

choices.label: Ask what it is
journal: They named it kindly. I filed the word away.

choices.label: Hide behind the chair
journal: Darkness was a blanket. I borrowed it.

title: Mud Pie Tax
prompt: The yard is wet. Someone older demands a mud pie as "road toll."

choices.label: Pay the pie
journal: I paid in mud. Diplomacy tasted like dirt.

choices.label: Argue the rate
journal: I talked them down to half a pie. Pride rose.

choices.label: Run the long way
journal: My boots won. The pie stayed mine.

title: One Mitten Missing
prompt: Winter air bites. One mitten is somewhere that is not your hand.

choices.label: Hunt the hedge
journal: I found it iced to a thorn. Fingers remembered warmth.

choices.label: Share the remaining
journal: We traded fingers. Cold became a game.

choices.label: Pretend you meant to
journal: Fashion, I said. No one believed me. Fine.

title: Spoon Drum Council
prompt: Kitchen spoons become a council. You are briefly Speaker.

choices.label: Keep the beat
journal: The pot answered. So did a neighbor.

choices.label: Resign the speakership
journal: I passed the spoon. Quiet returned, mostly.

choices.label: Invent a law
journal: No sticky hands before supper. Enforced poorly.

title: Taller Than Grass
prompt: The meadow hits your chin. Somewhere a parent calls a name that might be yours.

choices.label: Stand up tall
journal: I rose like a reed. The map shrank.

title: Bedtime Bargain
prompt: One more story is requested. The lantern is already half-asleep.

choices.label: Promise tomorrow
journal: I banked a story. Sleep arrived anyway.

choices.label: Tell a short one
journal: Three sentences. A dragon blinked. Done.

title: Pond Skipping Class
prompt: Flat stones wait. The pond grades generously.

choices.label: Teach a sibling
journal: Their stone sank with dignity. Mine cheered.

title: Nameday Ribbon
prompt: Someone ties a ribbon to your wrist. It means you are still you.

choices.label: Gift it onward
journal: It looked better on them. I kept the feeling.

title: Tidepool Toes
prompt: Glassmarket stones are wet and clever. Your toes negotiate.

choices.label: Chase a crab shadow
journal: I lost. The crab filed a complaint.

choices.label: Sit and listen
journal: Waves kept time better than spoons.

title: Reedpath Whistle
prompt: Thornreed gives a hollow stem if you ask politely with a knife.

choices.label: Leave the stem
journal: The reed kept its song. I kept my fingers.

choices.label: Trade for a better cut
journal: A taller kid knew the angle. Fair trade.

title: Chalk Stars
prompt: Spireward steps hold chalk dust. Someone draws a sky on stone.

choices.label: Add a comet
journal: My comet had a square tail. Original.

title: Warm Brick Seat
prompt: Emberlight bricks hold day-heat after dusk. You claim one.

choices.label: Share the brick
journal: Two sitters, one brick, zero war.

title: Bug Parade
prompt: A line of beetles has opinions about your thumb.

choices.label: Redirect gently
journal: I was a bridge. They forgave me.

choices.label: Name the leader
journal: General Dot. Promoted on the spot.

title: Listening to Rain
prompt: Rain on the roof invents a language. You almost understand.

choices.label: Translate aloud
journal: My translation involved soup. Close enough.

choices.label: Ask if rain has a name
journal: They said many. I picked one.

title: Pocket Crumb Treaty
prompt: A crumb in your pocket becomes foreign policy with a bird.

title: Slow Kettle Wisdom
prompt: The kettle takes longer. So do you. Neither of you apologizes.

choices.label: Use the leftover warm
journal: Efficiency of age. Tea still counts.

title: Name on the Bench
prompt: A commons bench remembers a generation. Yours is nearly carved.

choices.label: Carve a joke instead
journal: Future sitters will frown, then smile.

title: Teaching the Knot
prompt: A younger pair of hands fumbles a hitch you could tie asleep.

choices.label: Tie it once as demo
journal: Show, don't hover. They copied well.

choices.label: Admit your hands shake
journal: Honesty. They tied it for both of us.

title: Known Face Discount
prompt: A stallhand waves the price down without asking permission from math.

choices.label: Accept kindly
journal: I paid less and thanked more.

choices.label: Ask how long they've known you

title: Strategic Nap
prompt: Afternoon light hits the chair just so. Resistance is theatrical.

choices.label: Nap without guilt
journal: I woke wiser by twenty minutes.

choices.label: Nap with a book on your face

title: Letter Unsent
prompt: Ink dries on a letter you may never send. The page still helped.

title: Quiet Feast
prompt: Few guests, good bread, no speeches required. Perfect protocol.

choices.label: Bring food to theirs
journal: I traveled with a covered dish. Heroic.

title: Map Creases
prompt: Your personal map has more creases than roads. That is success.

choices.label: Gift the map
journal: Someone else can wear these creases.

title: Second-Century Tea
prompt: Long years make tea taste like continuity. You pour carefully.

choices.label: Invite a younger ear
journal: I told one true story. Kept three.

choices.label: Write the recipe down
journal: Future you will thank present you.

title: Standing Stone Visit
prompt: A stone older than your long life still does not blink. Respectful.

title: Joints as Weather Glass
prompt: Your knees predict rain better than the crier.

choices.label: Tell the crier
journal: They wrote it down. Science advanced.

title: Heirloom Sort
prompt: A chest opens. Half is treasure. Half is future kindling. Choices.

choices.label: Donate a share
journal: The chest breathed easier. So did I.

title: Rush Order Noon
prompt: A caravan wants twelve meals before the bell. The pot has opinions.

choices.label: Batch smart
journal: I batched. The bell forgave us.

title: Salt Debate
prompt: A regular swears you under-salted. The broth disagrees.

title: Burnt Edge Lesson
prompt: One tray goes dark at the corners. The hall still needs feeding.

title: Feast Eve Prep
prompt: Nameday eve. Knives flash. Lists multiply.

choices.label: Prep the night before
journal: Dawn found me ready. Rare miracle.

choices.label: Delegate chopping
journal: I directed. They chopped. Hierarchy tasted fine.

title: Forager Special
prompt: Wild greens arrive muddy and perfect. Menu rewrite required.

choices.label: Ask the forager's tip
journal: They knew a rinse trick. Adopted.

title: Empty Larder Panic
prompt: The larder looks philosophical: mostly air.

choices.label: Market sprint
journal: I returned with onions and dignity.

title: Apprentice Knife Fear
prompt: A new helper holds a knife like it might judge them.

title: Compliment Chain
prompt: A traveler says your bread reminds them of home. Then another.

choices.label: Gift a warm end-loaf
journal: They left lighter. So did I.

title: Warp Thread Snap
prompt: A warp thread gives up mid-pattern. The loom waits for a decision.

choices.label: Restring clean
journal: I cut back and reset. Pattern survived.

title: Dye Pot Spoil
prompt: The blue turns sulky overnight. Cloth queues look judgmental.

title: Rush Cloak Order
prompt: A traveler needs a cloak by dusk. Your shuttle disagrees.

title: Pattern Peek
prompt: Someone sketches your pattern from the doorway. Not subtle.

title: Loom Jam
prompt: The beater sticks. The day's length doubles in a second.

title: Winter Order Stack
prompt: Everyone wants wool at once. The pegboard looks like a blizzard.

title: Apprentice Tension
prompt: They pull weft too tight. Cloth buckles like a frown.

title: Festival Banner Job
prompt: The commons wants a banner that reads clear from the far stall.

choices.label: Collaborate with a painter
journal: Thread plus pigment. Crowd liked it.

title: Market List Lost
prompt: You had a list. The list had other plans.

choices.label: Ask a stallhand what you usually get

title: Neighbor Favor
prompt: A neighbor needs a heavy crate moved before rain.

title: Road Rumor
prompt: Two travelers argue which ford is safer. Both look wrong.

title: Tool Mend Evening
prompt: A handle loosens. Evening becomes a workshop.

title: Quiet Ledger Night
prompt: Numbers refuse to add until you sit still.

title: Festival Errand
prompt: Someone needs ribbon, nails, or both, before the lamps go up.

choices.label: Run the errand
journal: I returned with both. Applause lite.

title: Weather Shutters
prompt: Wind rises. Shutters argue with their hinges.

title: Small Kindness Queue
prompt: At the counter, someone short a coin looks at the floor.

title: Evening Forms
prompt: You run through forms in the yard until breath matches dusk.

title: Letter Toward Home
prompt: Ink, news, and one question you almost don't ask.

choices.label: Send warm news
journal: Courier took kindness down the road.

title: Notice Board Browse
prompt: You read notices you will never answer. Still useful weather.

title: Shared Fire
prompt: Strangers make a ring around a commons fire. Space appears for one more.

title: Roads Asking
prompt: At eleven the world starts asking which skills you will feed. Sword, spark, both, or craft — the choice is yours on Life or Skills.

choices.label: I'll choose soon
journal: I felt the fork in the road. Not lost — deciding.

choices.label: Ask a mentorish adult
journal: They said: pick what you return to after hard days.

choices.label: Already know
journal: I smiled like someone with a map.
